Zebracat vs VEXI: Faceless Video or Your Social Media?
Zebracat makes faceless AI videos and its AI agent queues a month of them. VEXI edits your own footage, designs posts and carousels, and posts it all.
Zebracat runs faceless video channels on its own. Here is how it compares with one app that runs your business's social media with your own face, footage and voice.

Zebracat turns a prompt, a blog or a script into faceless AI videos, with stock footage, AI scenes, voiceover and avatars. Its AI agent connects to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and LinkedIn, queues the month and publishes at the times your audience is online; you can approve each video or let it run. Cat Mode is $39 a month ($23 billed yearly), Super Cat is $99 and Unlimited Cat is $199.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Credit where it is due: Zebracat already posts on its own, and its AI agent plans further ahead than VEXI. It queues a month; VEXI Autopilot works a week ahead. The difference is what goes out. Zebracat makes faceless video. VEXI makes your feed: your own clips edited with B-roll, music and captions, designed posts and carousels, captions and long-form video, all from one conversation about your business. VEXI costs more than Zebracat: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
Zebracat is built for faceless videos from stock footage, AI scenes and avatars. Its pages do not describe editing the clips you filmed.
Send VEXI the clips you shot and they come back cut, with B-roll, music and captions, sized for each platform.
Every format on its pages is a video. It makes no designed posts or carousels.
VEXI designs the post with your logo, colors, fonts and voice. Tap anything on the design to change it.
Its pricing table caps videos at 2 minutes on Cat Mode and 5 minutes on the higher plans.
VEXI makes long-form videos on every plan, and turns a long recording into its best clips, captioned.
Zebracat is rated 4.4 on Trustpilot. Some reviewers report a renewal at a higher rate without notice and support that is hard to reach.

Can Zebracat edit my own videos?

Zebracat is built for faceless videos from stock footage, AI scenes and avatars, and its pages do not describe editing the clips you filmed. VEXI edits your own footage: cuts, B-roll, music and captions.
Does Zebracat make posts and carousels?
No. Every format on its pages is a video. VEXI also designs posts and carousels in your logo, colors and fonts, and writes their captions.
